name: Triggered Evaluation
description: The account whose push this rule suite evaluated. An ACCOUNT, not an identity: GitHub returns a login and a numeric id and does not say whether it belongs to a person, a bot or a machine account, so the edge points at the same user-or-organization primitive everything else does rather than claiming a classification we did not observe.

actor_id.description: GitHub's numeric account id at the time of the push. Carried so a login rename is detectable — the same id under a new login is a rename, not a new actor.
